hypotheses.D0_selection_is_discovery_frozen: All candidate rankings are selected on fold 0/split 0 and evaluated unchanged on the other five cells.
hypotheses.D1_contextual_occupied_outlier_selects_H: Routed rank-1 write RMS selects H2 on discovery and its selected head ranks among the top three positive finite heads in every held-out cell.
hypotheses.D2_output_quotient_selects_H2: The direct output-conditioned rank-1 tensor score selects H2 on discovery and its selected head is the top positive finite head in every held-out cell.
hypotheses.D3_quotient_score_predicts_finite_effect: Across all nine heads, direct quotient scores correlate at least 0.8 with finite rank-1 effects in every cell.
hypotheses.D4_rank1_preserves_H2_finite_effect: The H2 rank-1 intervention retains at least 90% of its full-edge signed finite effect in every cell.
hypotheses.D5_context_is_enough_without_semantic_ou: D1 holds, so the behavior-relevant head can be shortlisted without the output contrast.
